function.name: SET_DISTANCE
function.param: Number of channel returned by PLAY_WAV
function.abstract: It changes the volume of a channel

description.p: This function allows to modify the sound of a determined channel simulating a distance of the same one, from one distances to the player. Distance 0 leaves the sound as it were in the beginning, while a distance of 255 makes the sound inaudible.
This function leaks the sound of a channel without making use of the advanced characteristics of some sound cards. If you want a sophisticated emulation, is better to use .
